messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] structure
parts:
There are various methods for assessing population structure (mostly differentiation stats like Fst/Gst/AMOVA). STRUCTURE the program happens to be one method. If you want to use other methods, then you would want to import your csv file into R and transform it into a genind object (or gtypes, or loci). The strataG package (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/strataG/index.html) has a nice set of tools for accessing the outputs of external programs like STRUCTURE.

Hope that helps,
Zhian
